cards.questionText:
refer to the following e-mail and letter.
To: Raul Wolfe
From: Kelly Wagner
Date: March 19
Subject: Business Loan through Anoka Bank
Dear Mr. Wolfe,
My name is Kelly Wagner. I am following up on the appointment you had on March 4 regarding a loan for your dress-making business. I understand that you originally met with Constance Gauthier, but she has transferred to another branch, so I am taking over for her. As I'm sure Ms. Gauthier explained, the loan amount is dependent on your business's financial situation. Your business needs at least $125,000 in annual earnings for each of the past two years to be issued a $25,000 loan. If your annual earnings for each of the past two years have been $200,000 or more, then you would be eligible to receive $40,000.
The next step in processing your application is for you to send documents for verification. I will need a copy of your business plan, documents showing the salary payments to employees, your sixteen-digit business license number, and an overview of your business account for the past two years.
If the loan is approved, you will be notified by mail, and the loan amount will be deposited into your bank account three days after the approval date. As soon as the funds are deposited, you can access them for any business purpose.
Warmest regards,
Kelly Wagner
=====================================================
Raul Wolfe
524 Boswell Court
San Diego, CA 92101
April 7
Dear Mr. Wolfe,
We are pleased to inform you that Anoka Bank approved your business loan request this morning. Enclosed you will find a copy of the loan agreement, which you should retain for your records. A lump sum of $40,000 will be deposited in your bank account, and the payments will begin from May 15. A payment of $864.79 will be automatically taken from your account on the 15th of every month for a period of 60 months (five years). If you prefer, you may make larger payment in order to pay the loan off early.
Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact your designated loan officer, Kelly Wagner, at 5557947, extension 24.
Thank you for being an Anoka Bank customer!
The Anoka Bank Loans Team

childQuestions.questionText: What is implied about Ms. Wagner?
options: (A) She recently transferred to a new branch.
(C) She has not met Mr. Wolfe in person.
(D) She would like to reschedule a meeting.
correctOptions: (C) She has not met Mr. Wolfe in person.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information in the first passage: "I understand that you originally met with Constance Gauthier, but she has transferred to another branch, so I am taking over for her."

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì được ngụ ý về cô Wagner?

(A) Gần đây cô ấy đã chuyển đến một chi nhánh mới.

(B) Cô ấy là người giám sát của cô Gauthier.

(C) Cô ấy chưa gặp trực tiếp ông Wolfe.

(D) Cô ấy muốn lên lịch lại một cuộc họp.

Dựa trên thông tin ở đoạn đầu tiên:  "I understand that you originally met with Constance Gauthier, but she has transferred to another branch, so I am taking over for her."

(Tôi hiểu rằng ban đầu bạn đã gặp Constance Gauthier, nhưng cô ấy đã chuyển sang chi nhánh khác nên tôi sẽ tiếp quản cô ấy.)

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: What is NOT requested by Ms. Wagner for Mr. Wolfe's application?
childQuestions.transcript:
Information is in the first passage:

"I will need a copy of your business plan, documents showing the salary payments to employees, your sixteen-digit business license number, and an overview of your business account for the past two years."

=> Eliminate B,C,D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Cô Wagner KHÔNG yêu cầu điều gì trong đơn đăng ký của ông Wolfe?

(A) Giấy phép kinh doanh gốc

(B) Một kế hoạch kinh doanh

(C) Hồ sơ thanh toán

(D) Tóm tắt tài khoản

Thông tin ở đoạn 1:

"I will need a copy of your business plan, documents showing the salary payments to employees, your sixteen-digit business license number, and an overview of your business account for the past two years."

( Tôi cần một bản sao kế hoạch kinh doanh của bạn, các tài liệu chứng minh việc trả lương cho nhân viên, số giấy phép kinh doanh gồm mười sáu chữ số của bạn và tổng quan về tài khoản kinh doanh của bạn trong hai năm qua.)

=> Loại B,C,D => Chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: When will Mr. Wolfe be able to access the loan funds for the first time?
childQuestions.transcript:
In the second passage, there is information: "We are pleased to inform you that Anoka Bank approved your business loan request this morning."

Meanwhile, the letter is sent on April 7 => "This morning" is April 7, the approval date is April 7

In the first passage, it says that "If the loan is approved, you will be notified by mail, and the loan amount will be deposited into your bank account three days after the approval date."

=> Three days after the approval date is April 10.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Khi nào ông Wolfe mới có thể tiếp cận nguồn vốn vay lần đầu tiên?

(A) Vào ngày 7 tháng 4

(B) Vào ngày 8 tháng 4

(C) Vào ngày 10 tháng 4

(D) Vào ngày 15 tháng 4

Thông tin ở đoạn 2:

"We are pleased to inform you that Anoka Bank approved your business loan request this morning."(Chúng tôi vui mừng thông báo với bạn rằng Ngân hàng Anoka đã chấp thuận yêu cầu vay vốn kinh doanh của bạn vào sáng nay)

Trong khi đó thư gửi vào ngày 7/4 => “Sáng nay” là ngày 7/4, ngày phê duyệt là ngày 7/4

Thông tin đoạn 1: "If the loan is approved, you will be notified by mail, and the loan amount will be deposited into your bank account three days after the approval date." (Nếu khoản vay được chấp thuận, bạn sẽ được thông báo qua thư và số tiền cho vay sẽ được gửi vào tài khoản ngân hàng của bạn ba ngày sau ngày phê duyệt.)

=>  Ba ngày sau ngày phê duyệt là ngày 10/4.

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: What is suggested about Mr. Wolfe's business?
options: (A) It operates in more than one city.
(C) It will undergo a building project.
(D) It earned at least $200,000 last year.
correctOptions: (D) It earned at least $200,000 last year.
childQuestions.transcript:
In the second passage, there is information "A lump sum of $40,000 will be deposited in your bank account"

Meanwhile, in the first passage, it says that "If your annual earnings for each of the past two years have been $200,000 or more, then you would be eligible to receive $40,000."

=> It can be inferred that Mr. Wolfe's business earned at least $200,000 last year.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì được gợi ý về công việc kinh doanh của ông Wolfe?

(A) Nó hoạt động ở nhiều thành phố.

(B) Nó mở cửa cách đây hai năm.

(C) Nó sẽ trải qua một dự án xây dựng.

(D) Nó kiếm được ít nhất 200.000 đô la vào năm ngoái.

Thông tin ở đoạn 2: "A lump sum of $40,000 will be deposited in your bank account" (Một khoản tiền 40.000 USD sẽ được gửi vào tài khoản ngân hàng của bạn)

Thông tin ở đoạn 1: "If your annual earnings for each of the past two years have been $200,000 or more, then you would be eligible to receive $40,000."  (Nếu thu nhập hàng năm của bạn trong hai năm vừa qua là 40.000.)

=> Có thể suy ra rằng công việc kinh doanh của ông Wolfe kiếm được ít nhất 200.000 USD vào năm ngoái.

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: According to the letter, what part of the loan agreement is flexible?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in: "If you prefer, you may make larger payment in order to pay the loan off early."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Theo bức thư, phần nào của hợp đồng vay linh hoạt?

(A) Số tiền trả một lần

(B) Ngày đáo hạn hàng tháng

(C) Lãi suất

(D) Thời hạn thanh toán

Thông tin: "If you prefer, you may make larger payment in order to pay the loan off early."

(Nếu muốn, bạn có thể thanh toán số tiền lớn hơn để trả khoản vay sớm.)

=> Chọn D

cards.questionText:
refer to the following Web page and e-mail.
José Acevedo knew that he wanted to be a writer from a very young age. As a young boy growing up in Toronto, where he still lives today, he wrote short stories for his family and friends. He received a university degree in journalism before working at the Toronto Daily Herald. During that time, he was awarded the McKinley Prize, which is given for top reporting in a newspaper format. Mr. Acevedo then started publishing his own books, and he has four titles to date.
Plastic Universe, published 2012
A look into the modern world's addiction to plastic and its effects on wildlife and the environment. The book helped to further the discussion across the country on plastic use and its downsides.
Wind Revolution, published 2015
The book traces the history of wind turbines and their growing popularity as a sustainable energy source. It also outlines how individuals can get involved with using turbines on their own property.
Catching Up, published 2016
Acevedo interviews Toronto City Council members to investigate their efforts to adopt laws to the changing needs of the public, especially regarding technology and the environment.
Texas Treasures, published 2017
An undercover investigation into the oil industry in the U.S. state of Texas. Acevedo examines essential topics such as worker health, environmental protection, and corporate greed.
=====================================================
To: José Acevedo
From: Namiyo Sawada
Date: August 30
Subject: Documentary
Dear Mr. Acevedo,
I am currently working on a documentary, and I believe that the details from your latest book would be a great addition to my film. Your insights would be highly valuable to our viewers. I first became familiar with your work when my book club read your debut novel, and I have followed your career since then. I wanted to introduce myself first, but I will call you tomorrow to arrange a time to meet, if you are interested. I can come your way so you don't have to travel.
Namiyo Sawada
ZL Productions

childQuestions.questionText: Who are the intended recipients of the McKinley Prize?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the first passage: "he was awarded the McKinley Prize, which is given for top reporting in a newspaper format"
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Ai là người nhận giải thưởng McKinley?

(A) Tiểu thuyết gia

(B) Đạo diễn phim

(C) Nhà báo

(D) Các nhà hoạt động môi trường

Thông tin đoạn 1: "he was awarded the McKinley Prize, which is given for top reporting in a newspaper format"

(anh ấy đã được trao giải McKinley, giải thưởng được trao cho những bài báo xuất sắc nhất trên báo)

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: What is implied about Mr. Acevedo?
options: (A) He installed wind turbines on his property.
(B) He spoke with his local politicians.
(C) He has opened a new office in Texas.
(D) He will teach a university course.
correctOptions: (B) He spoke with his local politicians.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the first passage: "Acevedo interviews Toronto City Council members to investigate their efforts to adopt laws to the changing needs of the public"
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì được ngụ ý về ông Acevedo?

(A) Anh ấy đã lắp đặt tua-bin gió trên đất của mình.

(B) Anh ấy đã nói chuyện với các chính trị gia địa phương của mình.

(C) Anh ấy đã mở một văn phòng mới ở Texas.

(D) Anh ấy sẽ dạy một khóa học đại học.

Thông tin đoạn 1: "Acevedo interviews Toronto City Council members to investigate their efforts to adopt laws to the changing needs of the public"

(Acevedo phỏng vấn các thành viên Hội đồng Thành phố Toronto để điều tra nỗ lực của họ trong việc áp dụng luật nhằm đáp ứng nhu cầu đang thay đổi của công chúng)

=> Chọn B

childQuestions.questionText: Which book does Ms. Sawada want to feature in a documentary?
childQuestions.transcript:
In the second passage, there is information "I believe that the details from your latest book would be a great addition to my film."

Look at the first passage, we can see that the latest book of Acevedo is Texas Treasures, published 2017.

=> D is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Cô Sawada muốn giới thiệu cuốn sách nào trong phim tài liệu?

(A) Plastic Universe

(B) Wind Revolution

(C) Catching Up

(D) Texas Treasures

Thông tin đoạn 2: "I believe that the details from your latest book would be a great addition to my film."

(Tôi tin rằng những chi tiết trong cuốn sách mới nhất của bạn sẽ là sự bổ sung tuyệt vời cho bộ phim của tôi)

Thông tin đoạn 1 cho thấy cuốn sách mới nhất của Acevedo là Texas Treasures, xuất bản năm 2017.

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: What does Ms. Sawada hope to do on August 31?
childQuestions.transcript:
In the second passage, it says that "I wanted to introduce myself first, but I will call you tomorrow to arrange a time to meet, if you are interested."

The e-mail is sent on August 30 => tomorrow is August 31

=> A is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Cô Sawada hi vọng sẽ làm được gì vào ngày 31/8?

(A) Sắp xếp một cuộc hẹn

(B) Tham dự một cuộc họp

(C) Phát hành một video

(D) Thông báo về một câu lạc bộ sách

Thông tin đoạn 2: "I wanted to introduce myself first, but I will call you tomorrow to arrange a time to meet, if you are interested."

Email gửi vào ngày 30/8 => ngày mai là 31/8

 

=> Chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: In the e-mail, the word "way" in paragraph 1, is closest in meaning to
childQuestions.transcript:
method: a particular way of doing something

style: a way of doing something, especially one that is typical of a person, group of people, place, or period

feature: a typical quality or an important part of something

direction: the position towards which someone or something moves or faces

=> "direction" has the most appropriate meaning
childQuestions.explanationVi:
method: phương pháp

style: phong cách

feature: tính năng, đặc điểm

direction: phương hướng

Way: đướng lối

=> "direction" có nghĩa phù hợp nhất
